prompt: Turn this render into a photograph of a busy, energetic gym showcase: about 40 to 60 diverse adults (men and women, different ages and builds, modern athletic wear in mostly neutral and black tones with a few colour accents) actually using the equipment across every step of the stage: people on the benches pressing, someone squatting in the racks at the back, people on the treadmills, bikes and stair climber, someone hanging from the red monkey rig, people doing kettlebell swings and carrying dumbbells on the front steps, a coach watching. Each person correctly positioned on the machine they use, at true human scale relative to the equipment. Keep the exact camera angle, framing, stepped pale-grey concrete stage with black steel step edges, the grey gallery hall, and every piece of equipment exactly where it is in the reference image: same machines, same positions, same black frames, red Rogue rig uprights, colours and proportions. Do not add, remove or move any equipment. Make it a real photograph: soft skylight from above, natural shadows under people and machines, realistic skin, fabric and sweat, photoreal materials on the steel, upholstery and rubber. Shot like a high-end architectural / fitness editorial photo, crisp, slightly cinematic. No text overlays, no watermark.
